alerts.title: U.S. refineries have been running at very high rates in 2026
alerts.summary: The U.S. refinery fleet has run at higher-than-normal rates this year, with refinery utilization averaging more than 95% of capacity between May and September, the highest for those months since 1998. Tight global product supplies this year have boosted margins for petroleum products, particularly for diesel, incentivizing the increased run rates.

alerts.title: Germany Bets Big on Natural Gas to Keep the Lights On
alerts.summary: Gas-fired projects secured all 5.16 gigawatts (GW) of derated capacity in Germany's first capacity auction, with more than half going to developments at existing coal sites. The results show how the search for dependable backup power is giving established generators an advantage, while batteries missed out entirely. Derated capacity is adjusted to reflect each project's expected contribution to security of supply. As coal generation is being phased out and renewable capacity expands, Germany needs reliable backup power during prolonged periods…
